name: coupl
description: A DSL compiler for ComfyUI API graphs

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.core.json && npm run build:core && npm run check --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs packages/language-server/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.package:extension: npm run build && npm run package --workspace coupl-vscode
